Q: Cannot play video files in Tizen Web Apps A:

I encountered this exact issue on Windows. The problem is often caused by how Tizen Studio handles media codecs and hardware acceleration on that OS.

Solution: Switch to Linux.

The same code and Tizen Studio setup work perfectly on Ubuntu without any changes.

Q: String (with up to 100 chars) to int in c++ A:

You need to use a bignum library, like GNU MP aka GMP or libcrypto.

Since in a 64-bit environment most compiler use 64 bits for a long long int, you can't even reach near 100 decimal digits with a long long.

Q: Is there a way to average a group of averages pulled together in one Excel formula? A:

First of all, get your data in a Table, that will make everything you do easier. Then add a helper column that uses an AVERAGEIFS to calculate the monthly average. This average will be on every line and will be identical for each line in each month, then you can average that field and you will get a weighted average. If JAN has 15 lines and FEB has 100 lines, the FEB average will be carry more weight towards the final average since it has more lines (see Rory's excellent explanation of this issue).
